name: edshield
description: Student-privacy PII scrubber (edshield, rules layer). Detects and redacts names introduced with a cue, emails, phones, usernames/handles, URLs, IDs, street addresses, SSNs and dates from text under a FERPA, COPPA or research policy. Returns redacted text and entity counts.
quality_note: rule layer only (no neural model); catches handles and cued names that the cheap stub misses
